metadata.excerpt: A district-by-district directory of candidates for the Montana Senate in Montana’s 2026 election, including party, incumbency, campaign links and seats that are not on this year’s ballot.

components.text: 2026 Montana Senate Candidates by District
Montana Free Press
Election guide · House candidates · Voting information

Montanans elect 100 state representatives to two-year terms and 25 of 50 state senators to four-year terms in each even-year election. This year's election is the second to be conducted using a new legislative district map drawn to account for population shifts recorded by the 2020 census. Each Senate district is composed of two House districts.
Use the interactive address lookup to find your legislative districts
